FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
items.summary: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. items.title: Telescopic Language Models
items.summary: One deployed language model must often serve many compute budgets, yet serving each budget still means a separate training or compression run per point. We train a Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to be that continuum: a nested-capacity Transformer supervised by stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor. items.summary: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. items.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
items.summary: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. items.title: Neural Harmonic Measure Operator
items.summary: We introduce Neural Harmonic Measure Operator (NHMO), a neural solver for elliptic PDE problems on variable-shape domains. items.title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. items.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
items.summary: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation.
